title: 第7章 白瞎了这么好听的声音

content_zh:
他的气息，将她包围。
一种淡淡的薄荷香，驱散了石缝中的潮味，他呼吸平稳，心跳有力，云画的大脑都有些晕！
“专心点，好戏开场了！”低沉的声音在她耳边响起，更可恶的是，他居然……
他居然拽她的马尾！
云画只觉得自己全身的血液都往头上涌去！
她就要爆炸了！
她恨不得把背后靠近她的男人一脚踹开，可好戏的另外一个主演已经登场，她只能维持目前这个姿势，一动不动地专心看好戏。
贺御翔走近的时候，桃林碑后面的韩露露，刚要把衣服拧干。
听到脚步声传来，韩露露的脸色立刻变了。
“贺……贺御翔？是你吗？”韩露露咬牙问道，声音带着微微的颤音，显然她的心情也不平静。
那边的脚步声顿了顿，没人说话，而后继续靠近。
贺御翔走到桃林碑旁边，看到了蜷缩着的韩露露。
“怎么，有胆子约我出来，这会儿又没胆子见我？装什么装？”男生的声音里充斥着不屑和轻蔑。
此刻云画的身体也越发僵硬，各种滋味涌上心头。
贺御翔说的话，跟前世她经历这个场景的时候，一模一样，一个字都没变，就连语气都一模一样。
“我……我现在有些不太方便……”韩露露的声音微微发颤。
即便她性格大大咧咧，因为有一个当交代主任的父亲，她脾气也有些骄纵，但在喜欢的男生面前，她同样自卑而胆怯，并不比当年的云画要强多少。
韩露露不敢让贺御翔看到她此刻的样子。
可是贺御翔却不管那么多。
他直接走到了桃林碑的后面，看见了此刻一身狼狈的韩露露。

此刻石缝中。
云画整个人已经完全僵硬。
虽然她并非是真的懵懂少女，可此刻跟一个陌生男人如此近距离待在狭小的空间，她还是各种窘迫，各种不舒服。
一想到自己身后这个不知道什么时候躲进来的男人，云画整个人就有些晕。
他几乎把云画给圈在了怀中，也为她挡住了假山石头的棱角……
她挪动了一下身体，想要远离他一点，可这石缝的空间太小了。
云画已经羞恼得快要无地自容了。
“你，你过去点！”云画恼怒地道。
“过去？丫头，讲点道理，这地方就这么点儿，我一个人待着正好，你自己闯进来霸占了我的地盘，还好意思让我过去？”男人的声音低沉黯哑，好听得让人迷醉，“总要讲究个先来后到吧。”
以前老是听人形容某人的声音好听得让耳朵怀孕，如今她也算是亲身体会到了！
好听是真好听，可惜对方是个流氓，白瞎了这好声音！
云画心中暗恨。
此刻，桃林碑的现场。
韩露露又羞又窘，整个人低着头恨不得躲起来。
贺御翔却冷笑了一声，一把拽住她拿在手里的短袖，声音更加轻蔑：“韩露露，原来是你啊。你可真不要脸，约我出来就出来是想干什么？想让我对你做什么？”

content_en:
His breath surrounded her.
A faint scent of mint dissipated the smell of moisture in the cracks of the rocks. His breathing was steady, his heartbeat was strong, and Yun Hua's brain felt a little dizzy!
"Pay attention, the show is about to begin!" A deep voice sounded in her ears. What was even more disgusting was that he actually...
He actually pulled her ponytail!
Yun Hua felt that all the blood in his body was rushing to his head!
She's about to explode!
She wished she could kick away the man who was approaching her from behind, but the other star of the show had already appeared, so she could only maintain her current position and concentrate on watching the show motionlessly.
When He Yuxiang approached, Han Lulu, who was behind the Taolin Monument, was about to wring out her clothes.
Hearing the sound of footsteps, Han Lulu's expression immediately changed.
"He... He Yuxiang? Is that you?" Han Lulu gritted her teeth and asked, her voice trembling slightly. It was obvious that she was not in a calm mood either.
The footsteps over there paused for a moment, no one spoke, and then continued to approach.
He Yuxiang walked to the Taolin Monument and saw Han Lulu curled up.
"Why, you have the guts to ask me out, but now you don't have the guts to see me? Why are you pretending?" The boy's voice was full of disdain and contempt.
At this moment, Yun Hua's body became stiffer and stiffer, and all kinds of feelings came to his mind.
What He Yuxiang said was exactly the same as when she experienced this scene in her previous life. Not a word changed, and even the tone was exactly the same.
"I...I'm a little inconvenient right now..." Han Lulu's voice trembled slightly.
Even though she has a carefree personality and has a somewhat arrogant temper because she has a father who is the director of accounting, she is still inferior and timid in front of the boy she likes, and is not much better than Yun Hua back then.
Han Lulu didn't dare let He Yuxiang see what she looked like at this moment.
But He Yuxiang didn't care about that much.
He walked directly to the back of the Taolin Monument and saw Han Lulu who was in a miserable state.
At this moment, there is a crack in the stone.
Yun Hua's whole body was completely stiff.
Although she was not really an ignorant girl, she was still embarrassed and uncomfortable being in such a small space with a strange man at such a close distance.
Yun Hua felt a little dizzy when he thought of the man behind him who had hidden in at some unknown time.
He almost held Yun Hua in his arms and blocked the edges of the rockery stones for her...
She moved her body, trying to get further away from him, but the space between the rocks was too small.
Yun Hua was so embarrassed that he was almost ashamed.
"You, come over here!" Yun Hua said angrily.
"Go? Girl, be honest, this place is just that much. I can just stay alone. You barged in and occupied my territory. How dare you let me go?" The man's voice was low and hoarse, and it was so mesmerizing that it sounded so good. "You have to be on a first-come, first-served basis."
In the past, she always heard people describe someone's voice as so beautiful that it made her ears pregnant, but now she has experienced it herself!
It sounds really good, but it's a pity that the other party is a gangster, and this good voice is lost in vain!
Yun Hua felt secretly resentful.
At this moment, the scene of the Taolin Monument.
Han Lulu was ashamed and embarrassed. She lowered her head and wanted to hide.
He Yuxiang sneered, grabbed the short sleeves she was holding, and said in an even more contemptuous voice: "Han Lulu, it's you. You are so shameless. What do you want to do when you ask me out? What do you want me to do to you?"
